task.title: P6-134: Consolidate the three percent-encoders and route cursor through it at all native call sites
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, Catalog, search and paging). Original id: P6-134. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/data-access-backends.md.

**Consolidate the three percent-encoders into one module and route the unencoded `cursor` through it at all three native call sites** (was `P6-041` + `P6-096`, confirmed 2026-07-30 as one job). `backend/native.rs:221-223` sends only `q` through `urlencode`, so a hand-pasted `/catalog?cursor=x%26limit%3D200` injects extra upstream parameters on Android/desktop — and the same gap is pre-existing in `collection_view` and `all_cards`, which is why fixing only the catalog site would leave the pattern inconsistent. Bounded (own session only, no auth material in the query string, RLS still scopes the read) so it is hygiene rather than an auth hole. The three encoders — `catalog::encode_query_value` (query values, shared with `/my`), `shell::encode_path_for_query` (paths, keeps `/` literal), `backend::native::urlencode` (the native client) — have real differences that are undocumented as a set, so the next surface will pick one by proximity rather than by rule.
